departure-and-arrival.description: Complete a real departure and arrival sequence: prepare documents, pass the terminal checks, board and reach the destination.
departure-and-arrival.learningGoal: Handle documents, luggage, timing and directions across a practical air or rail journey.
lessons: Find the correct counter, present travel documents and handle luggage safely
您好，请出示护照和机票。
Nínhǎo, qǐng chūshì hùzhào hé jīpiào.
Hello, please show your passport and ticket.
好的。这个航班在哪个柜台办理？
Hǎo de. Zhège hángbān zài nǎge guìtái bànlǐ?
Okay. Which counter handles this flight?
在十二号柜台，行李也在那里办理。
Zài shí'èr hào guìtái, xíngli yě zài nàli bànlǐ.
At counter 12; luggage is handled there too.
Bàn wán yǐhòu qù ānjiǎn, duì ma?
After that I go to security, right?
You have arrived at an unfamiliar airport with a suitcase. Find the correct counter, present the required documents and ask where security is.
Confirm where luggage and security are handled
Interpret entrance, exit, delay and seat information before boarding
Does this flight depart on time?
Which entrance do I use to board?
从三号入口，请先准备好票。
Cóng sān hào rùkǒu, qǐng xiān zhǔnbèi hǎo piào.
Entrance 3; please have your ticket ready.
A departure is delayed and the gate area has several entrances. Confirm the delay, find the boarding entrance and locate your seat.
Ask whether departure is on time
Use rail and destination information to finish the journey or make a connection
Collect the ticket at the station.
Go to the high-speed rail platform.
去目的地坐火车还是高铁？
Qù mùdìdì zuò huǒchē háishi gāotiě?
Do we take a train or high-speed rail to the destination?
Zuò gāotiě, zài chēzhàn xiān qǔ piào.
Take high-speed rail and collect the ticket at the station.
Which platform does it leave from?
Wǔ hào zhàntái, xiàng yòu zǒu.
After arriving, you must continue by rail. Choose the correct train, collect the ticket and follow directions to the platform.
Ask where to collect the ticket

getting-around-town.description: Choose local transport, follow stop and transfer information, then complete the last part of a city journey.
getting-around-town.learningGoal: Ask for a route, use public transport and recover from a delay or wrong direction in Chinese.
lessons: Compare bus, subway and taxi options and buy the ticket you need
Take the subway to the station.
Qù shì zhōngxīn zuò shénme chē?
What transport should I take downtown?
坐地铁最快，也可以坐公共汽车。
Zuò dìtiě zuì kuài, yě kěyǐ zuò gōnggòng qìchē.
The subway is fastest; you can also take the bus.
Bù yuǎn, jiù zài chēzhàn pángbiān.
No, it is beside the station.
You must reach the city centre and can take a bus, subway or taxi. Compare the options and state which ticket you need.
Get on, count stops, transfer if needed and get off at the correct place
Get off at the next stop.
Wǒ zài nǎ yí zhàn shàngchē?
At which stop do I board?
需要，坐三站以后下车，在对面换。
Xūyào, zuò sān zhàn yǐhòu xiàchē, zài duìmiàn huàn.
Yes. Get off after three stops and transfer opposite.
A local route includes one transfer. Confirm where to board, count the stops and identify the correct place to change.
Confirm where to transfer and get off
Use a map and address, respond to traffic and walk the final directions
Give the address to the driver.
Driver, this is the hotel address.
前面堵车，只能到这个路口。
Qiánmiàn dǔchē, zhǐ néng dào zhège lùkǒu.
There is traffic ahead; I can only reach this intersection.
How do I walk after getting off?
看地图，向左边步行五分钟。
Kàn dìtú, xiàng zuǒbiān bùxíng wǔ fēnzhōng.
Check the map and walk left for five minutes.
Your taxi cannot reach the exact address because of traffic. Show the address, confirm the drop-off point and follow walking directions.
Repeat left or right walking directions

hotel-stay.description: Complete a hotel stay from reservation and check-in to room requests, problem reporting and checkout.
hotel-stay.learningGoal: Check in with documents, use hotel facilities and solve a room or payment issue politely.
lessons: Confirm a reservation, present identification and leave luggage safely
您好，我预订了一个房间。
Nínhǎo, wǒ yùdìng le yí ge fángjiān.
请问客人姓名？请出示证件。
Qǐngwèn kèrén xìngmíng? Qǐng chūshì zhèngjiàn.
What is the guest name? Please show identification.
这是我的护照，行李可以放在哪儿？
Zhè shì wǒ de hùzhào, xíngli kěyǐ fàng zài nǎr?
Here is my passport. Where can I leave my luggage?
You can leave it beside reception.
You have a reservation and luggage but do not know the check-in procedure. Confirm the booking, provide identification and ask about luggage.
State that a room was reserved
Present a passport or other document
Ask where luggage can be stored
Find the room and ask about breakfast, bathroom items and climate control
Take the elevator to the fifth floor.
There is air conditioning in the room.
Wǒ de fángjiān zài jǐ lóu?
Which floor is my room on?
Zài wǔ lóu, zuò yòubiān de diàntī.
It is on the fifth floor; take the elevator on the right.
早餐几点开始？房间里有毛巾吗？
Zǎocān jǐ diǎn kāishǐ? Fángjiān lǐ yǒu máojīn ma?
When does breakfast start? Are there towels in the room?
七点开始，浴室里有两条毛巾。
Qī diǎn kāishǐ, yùshì lǐ yǒu liǎng tiáo máojīn.
It starts at seven; there are two towels in the bathroom.
You have received a key but still need to find the floor and understand the main room facilities. Ask three practical questions.
Check a bathroom or air-conditioning item
Report a room problem, request service and confirm charges or deposit
The guest room is too noisy.
您好，房间的网络坏了，而且晚上很吵。
Nínhǎo, fángjiān de wǎngluò huài le, érqiě wǎnshang hěn chǎo.
Hello, the room internet is broken and it is noisy at night.
对不起，我们马上安排服务。
Sorry, we will arrange service immediately.
明天离开时，费用和押金怎么结算？
Míngtiān líkāi shí, fèiyong hé yājīn zěnme jiésuàn?
How are the charges and deposit settled when I leave tomorrow?
前台会列出费用，押金会退给您。
Qiántái huì lièchū fèiyong, yājīn huì tuì gěi nín.
Reception will list the charges and return the deposit.
The room is noisy and the internet does not work. Report both issues, request action and confirm the final charges before leaving.
Describe the broken or noisy item
